info.title: EU AI Act Risk Tagging Demo LLM API
info.description: A minimal OpenAI-compatible chat-completions mock upstream used to demo the C3 EU AI Act Use-Case Risk Tagging Flex Gateway policy. The mock echoes the x-jev-ai-act-risk header the policy injects into the request into a received_risk_tag field in the response body, so the injected tag is visible in the demo. Provider: P4A Policies for Agents (https://github.com/P4A-Policies-for-Agents).

post.description: Accepts an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions request. The governing C3 gateway policy classifies the EU AI Act risk band of the use case declared in the system prompt / last user message before this endpoint is ever called, injecting x-jev-ai-act-risk upstream (or denying with 403 for prohibited/unregistered high-risk uses). This mock echoes the received tag into received_risk_tag.

200.description: A mock chat completion. Reflects the received x-jev-ai-act-risk request header into the body so the injected tag is visible.

received_risk_tag.description: The x-jev-ai-act-risk header the gateway injected (echoed by the mock).
